title: Love at Fourteen
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Middle schoolers Kanata Tanaka and Kazuki Yoshikawa, childhood friends seen by classmates as unusually mature, are drawn to each other but unsure how to act on it. The quiet, nostalgic story follows their secret first romance through school days and festivals, with side stories about classmates, including one student's storyline with a music teacher.
life_message: First love is tender and confusing, and growing up means learning to name and share what you feel.
